notes.title: v1.4.3 with Replay Handling
notes.content: Added replay handling for starting, stopping, and saving the replay buffer in both OBS and Streamlabs OBS. Have a look and if there's any issues let us know!

notes.title: v1.5.0 in Beta Channel
notes.content:
We're pushing a new version into the Beta channel now. It has a couple of new test things.

NOTE! This version may have crashes!

You can switch to the beta channel from Properties, Betas on Steam. There's no beta key, just select the beta version and close.

You can switch away from beta version if you have issues with it, just opt out of betas in the same place.

So what's new? There's a couple of things.

UI Simplification
Tired of looking at so many options when you just want to set the audio file to play? Now in Multifunctions there's no image/color/etc settings. They don't matter. And soon we will also declutter the Button actions a bit more. Let's put the more important stuff to the top instead of the bottom.

Reactions
If you click Edit, Reactions you get to a new screen where you can add Reactions. The idea is that these are not things you'd have as buttons but rather as reactions to chat, hotkeys, MIDI, bits, channel points... all kinds of things. So just add a Reaction, set when it fires, and what it does (like a Multifunction).

Currently we only support Chat commands and MIDI commands, but during the beta we will push the other stuff out too.

MIDI
As mentioned above, we now support MIDI, for buttons/keys. So far only in Reactions, but also coming to Buttons.

The app will automatically connect to all MIDI input devices available and will allow you to press a button/key on your device to bind to a Reaction. Later on we will add slider/knob support etc. Stay tuned!

There's other things in the pipeline too and some you can read between the lines. Stay tuned and happy betaing!

notes.title: v1.3.7 with Fixes and Previous Stuff
notes.content:
v1.3.7 fixes an issue with some users and hotkeys not registering correctly on startup. They should now all be handled properly.

Also previoysly not reported new things:


 Filter enable/disable. Add funny filter to your voice? Turn it on or off with the push of a button! Same with video filters
 Version check so that OBS Studio and OBS WebSocket aren't too old. If they are too old there will be issues with compatibility
 Support for newer version of mobile app which loads images to buttons differently. This should make for a bit snappier interface
 Fix deselecting hotkey for an action

notes.title: v1.1.3 Released with bug fixes
notes.content:
Version 1.1.3 is now out with a couple of bug fixes:


 Control key works properly in keypresses
 Alt key works properly in keypresses
 A capital letter in hold keys may cause hang
 Multimedia button "previous" sent "play/pause" instead


Also added a feature of sending AltGr in keypresses with # modifier instead of the % for left alt.

There's still a few things in need of checking in the key handling but this should fix the problems reported to us. Once again, thank you very much for the reports!

notes.title: v1.1.1 and Future
notes.content:
We've published v1.1.1 with a couple of changes:


 Fixed key press command, it only accepted the {home} etc written in lowercase
 Added Streamlabs Roll Credits functionality
 Changed the UI style slightly


Thanks for the comments and reports!

Also about the future. Since we have a strong feature set working we're going to focus on a couple of usability things next. The programmability features aren't the best since they are just the same grid and it's not obvious how they work. We wanted to have a nice tree structure to make it clear from the start but it was faster to get the product out this way. So next we will make the programmable functions look proper so it's clear what is happening when you press a button.

If you have any comments, feedback, bugs, anything, just send a message or join the Discord!

notes.title: v1.0.9 with User Interface Enhancements, Counters, Backup etc
notes.content:
v1.0.9

We're pushing out a hot new version with some nice changes:


 Counters have an UI to add and edit them. No more random names in settings, only existing counters can be used
 Button settings have tooltips! Hover on the setting and you'll get information on what it does
 You can back up and restore your decks in Settings, also useful for copying to another machine
 You can export a button, including folders and multifunctions, and import them to another place, machine, wherever via context menu
 You can select a button and embed it in a folder if you're running out of space via context menu
 Settings are saved automatically leaving edit mode, no need for separate button press
 You can revert changes to buttons before exiting edit mode if things went wrong


So do back up your settings from time to time to make sure you don't accidentally break anything while playing around, or if you want to copy them to another machine.

And with the export/import function you can even share your actions with friends! Made a cool multifunction and want them to have it? Just export and give it to them!

Older updates

Seems we haven't explained changes in previous versions, so let's recap:


 Elgato Stream Deck alpha support. Enable in settings, doesn't work with confirmation requests and you must not have any other app using it at the same time
 Timer added, you can create a timer that ticks down on the screen, for example, a Be Right Back ticker
 Fixes for several Streamlabs OBS issues
 Color picker shows the colors you're using already for easy matching
 Fix for random image


We hope this update makes Stream Control even nicer to use for everyone. Let us know!

notes.title: Open For Business, What's Next?
notes.content:
We are now open for business! Tokavuh Stream Control is available for purchase and you can grab it for yourself for immediate use. We are not sitting idly waiting for your patronage but are actively working on the product.

Some things we have planned for the near future:


Better manual
Videos on how to do specific things
User interface enhancements
iOS app to the store
Android app enhancements
Get Streamlabs OBS support to alpha stage
Backing up settings
Import/export for settings


There are also many actual new features waiting to be implemented, but we want to focus on getting the main system running well, documentation up to par so it's easy to set up and use, and everything going smoothly before we tackle new things.

We're open to all comments and welcome any feedback you might have. We appreciate every user and try to answer all questions you might have. We are a small company doing this because we love streamers and want to provide good tools to help everyone's work.
